primary_metric: Pearson r squared. Store signed Pearson r for each section and inspection.
aggregate: Rank by maximum arithmetic mean of per-profile r squared unless the scheme explicitly ranks by pooled r squared. Aggregate undefined if any constituent profile is undefined. Minimum 3 rows. Flag profiles under 10 rows.
evidence_status: Previously viewed development diagnostics, one parent pipeline. Compare identical keys, measured minima, dates and folds. Later campaigns and same-day geometry are outside these comparisons.

batch_01.H01: Require independently verified pre-cutoff coordinate ties to the target reference.
batch_01.H02: Reparse Distance, residual thickness and defect depth by source record, using the confirmed 2018 fraction rule.
batch_01.H03: Require dated construction map and verified local nominal thickness.
batch_01.H04: Remove one predeclared category from historical VTD features and S2 fold training. Keep evaluation keys and measured minima immutable.
batch_01.H05: S1 only. Require comparable eligible UZT with date and position.
